title: Explosion at Aeon shopping center in Kumamoto after earthquake leaves multiple victims
summary: An explosion destroys part of the Aeon shopping center in Kumamoto after the quake, causing at least several dead, injured and missing; rescue teams work in the area.

title: Prime Minister Takaichi confirms 13 dead in Kumamoto earthquake
summary: The Japanese Prime Minister officially reports 13 deaths and promises to mobilize all resources for assistance in the affected areas.

title: Collapse at Nippon Seishi paper factory in Yatsushiro leaves five dead and four missing
summary: The collapse of a chimney at the Nippon Seishi plant during the earthquake causes five deaths and four workers unaccounted for.

title: Kumamoto earthquake disrupts roads and Shinkansen bullet train in Kyushu
summary: The earthquake damages bridges and causes closure of highways and suspension of Shinkansen service in the Kyushu region, with plans for gradual resumption.

title: Kumamoto earthquake paralyzes semiconductor and automobile factories in Kyushu
summary: The suspension of operations at semiconductor and automobile plants in Kyushu after the quake threatens the global supply chain of chips and auto parts.

title: Japan's government proposes reducing consumption tax on food to 1% amid controversy
summary: Prime Minister Takaichi announces the reduction of consumption tax for basic food items, but the national social security committee fails to reach consensus and the opposition criticizes the measure.

title: Japan raises minimum wage to 1,176 yen per hour, the largest increase in six years
summary: The Japanese government approves a record increase in the national minimum wage, amid a debate on inflation and purchasing power.

title: Kumamoto earthquake prompts Japanese companies to strengthen disaster preparedness
summary: The quake in Kumamoto motivates companies to review their business continuity and crisis management plans to improve resilience.

title: Fukuoka scandal over leak of opposition questions to ruling party lawmakers
summary: It is revealed that officials of Fukuoka prefecture leaked draft questions from the opposition to members of the Liberal Democratic Party, generating criticism.

title: Japan's population falls below 120 million for the first time in 42 years
summary: Japan's population decreases by more than 900,000 people and births reach a historic low, according to government data.

title: Iran attacks US base in Jordan and US responds with bombings against pro-Iranian militias
summary: Tensions in the Middle East rise after Iranian attack on US base in Jordan and subsequent US retaliation against Iranian targets.

title: Experts warn that Kumamoto earthquake could be an aftershock of the 2016 major quake
summary: Geologists recommend caution given the possibility that the recent quake is an aftershock of the 2016 earthquake and suggest preparing for more aftershocks.

title: Magnitude 5.8 earthquake shakes Kumamoto prefecture without tsunami warning
summary: A magnitude 5.8 earthquake with epicenter in Kumamoto reaches a seismic intensity of 5 lower, with no reported damage to nuclear plants.

title: Heatwave in Japan causes more than 18,500 emergencies and 45 deaths in one week
summary: High temperatures cause a record increase in hospitalizations for heatstroke in Japan, especially affecting those evacuated from the Kumamoto earthquake.

title: International reactions to Kumamoto earthquake: condolences and offers of help
summary: Media around the world cover the quake, while South Korea expresses solidarity and Taiwan prepares to send assistance.

title: New magnitude 4 aftershocks shake Kumamoto after the main earthquake
summary: Two magnitude 4 quakes are recorded in the Kumamoto region, with no reports of major damage or tsunami warning.

title: Yen weakens to 163 yen per dollar amid expectations of Fed and BoJ meetings
summary: The Japanese currency falls to levels of 163 yen per dollar, with investors awaiting monetary policy decisions from the Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan.
